audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Riven six of seven stages including first item and 2+ items, while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] all say the lane flips to Kayle from 6 onward and 'she has no late-game answer to ranged Kayle'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Riven / Riven / Riven / Skill / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle, matching the prose. Kayle wins 51.71%; the item stages are hers.
audit.corrected: Row 3 -> Skill, rows 4, 5 and 6 -> Kayle; rows 0-2 stay Riven. Flipped in matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly sited: Riven levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Kayle 2+ items. The level-11 Divine Ascent reference in spikes[3] is right — that is the Aflame wave step, with ranged form already at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Broken Wings' third cast is called a knockup in four places. Riot's description says the third hit knocks back nearby enemies — the kit's derived 'knockup' flag contradicts the text. No cooldowns are given, and Broken Wings' flat 13s at every rank is the single most important number in the matchup.
audit.why: Knockback and knockup are not interchangeable for a champion with no dash: a knockback moves you away from her, which is survivable and sometimes good, while bracing for airborne time changes when you cast. And once all three Q casts are spent, she has 13 seconds with no gap-close — that is precisely the window Kayle steps up in. Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s.
audit.corrected: Call it the third-cast knockback, and write the flat 13s Broken Wings window in as the punish trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late says 'anti-heal stays core' and report[8] says 'his healing fights your pattern'. Riven's kit contains no healing at all — Runic Blade, Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Blade of the Exile are damage, CC, a dash-shield and an AD steroid.
audit.why: Telling a Kayle to buy Executioner's into Riven wastes an item slot in a matchup where she needs range and damage instead. Valor is a shield, which anti-heal does not touch.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal advice removed from breakdown.late and replaced with the real requirement — range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ki Burst's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing and Radiant Blast's shred keep you breathing, but her burst still wins the extended trade — a coin-flip, so play it safe.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment blanks the Q-into-Ki Burst all-in or Wind Slash — bait all three dashes, then R the commit.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ki Burst's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's ranged autos and Starfire's missing-HP on-hit kite her flat 13s Q from outside her reach.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Riven carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You out-range and out-scale her — she burns three dashes and her E shield just to touch you, and W peels her off.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Survive it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — 11/10/9/8/7s stun that starts every all-in. Survive it, then step up. - Broken Wings: a flat 13s once all three casts are spent — that is your window. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — build your teamfight around that. Riven carry threat: 8/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — build your teamfight around that. Riven carry threat: 8/10 — she has no healing to cut, so buy range and damage and shift to picks if she leads.

edits.before: Riven's level-1 Broken Wings dashes plus base damage out-trade your single short-range auto — you own nothing here, so last-hit and never get knocked up.
edits.after: Riven's level-1 Broken Wings dashes plus base damage out-trade your single short-range auto — you own nothing here, so last-hit and dodge the third cast.

edits.before: Riven's three Broken Wings dashes with the third-cast AoE knockup, comboed into her Ki Burst stun, is a melee all-in that can delete you while your autos are still short-range and you have one rank of W heal.
edits.after: Riven's three Broken Wings dashes with the third-cast knockback, comboed into an 11s Ki Burst stun, is a melee all-in that deletes you while your autos are still short-range and Celestial Blessing is rank 1.

edits.before: Land Q3 knockup into Ki Burst stun to lock you in melee and burst you down before level 6
edits.after: Land the Q3 knockback into Ki Burst stun to lock you in melee and burst you before level 6

edits.before: Last-hit at max range through levels 1-5, sidestepping her Q3 knockup and never standing in Ki Burst stun range
edits.after: Last-hit at max range through levels 1-5, sidestepping her third Q cast and staying out of Ki Burst's 260 range

notes: All three suspectNames are false positives (Divine Judgment, Divine Ascent). report[8] still tells the player to buy Oblivion Orb / Executioner's 'early — his healing fights your pattern' into a Riven who has no healing; report[N].t is writable, but the string is shared boilerplate across the champion's matchups, so it is flagged here rather than edited in isolation — a human should decide whether to strip the anti-heal clause per matchup.
